# Native hooks

This manual covers synchronous interception points (Hooks) in CCB.

## `on_character_death` { #symbol-api-lua-v5-generated-hook-on-character-death-15ad1b50a8ab }

```lua
-- Register hook interceptor
game.hooks.on("on_character_death", function(character, killer)
    -- Intercept and return result
end)
```

🛡️ **Required Capabilities:** `events`, `game.hooks`

**Sources:**

- [`src/catalua_ui_callbacks.cpp:15`](https://github.com/CrimsonCrossBunker/Cataclysm-Cleanwater-Bomb/blob/d32b9cc880a85480840d82cfa05d256c78a16615/src/catalua_ui_callbacks.cpp#L15) — native hook registry
